title: Analogue simulation of massive relativistic quantum fields in 2 + 1 dimensions
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11268-y

Analogue simulation of massive relativistic quantum fields in 2 + 1 dimensions (two spatial dimensions and time) is realized using two coherently coupled spin components in a two-dimensional atomic Bose–Einstein condensate.
